messages:
devsecops-bot: ALERT: security-group sg-0a1b2c3d updated in prod (eu-west-1). New ingress: 0.0.0.0/0 tcp 22. Triggered by principal: aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ci-runner-role
samir: seen. who pushed that change? looks like a terraform apply touched the SG today.
maria: yep, I just ran a deploy for the model-serving job at 10:18. I thought that change was coming from a temp rule in the module for testing — I removed it locally but maybe the CI used the wrong workspace.
ben: can we get the exact event from CloudTrail? need principal and API call.
samir: querying now. cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=sg-0a1b2c3d --max-results 1
samir: Got it: EventId=abcd-ef12, EventName=AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress, UserIdentity.type=AssumedRole, userIdentity.arn=arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ci-runner-role/session
elena: @maria which pipeline? buildkite or github-actions?
maria: buildkite job: buildkite/redwood-model-deploy #457. I added a temporary var to open ssh to debug a flaky init script. I thought the var only set in dev workspace. my bad.
ben: ok containment: remove the rule immediately and revert the terraform state change. I can revoke the ingress now.
samir: revoking via CLI: aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
devsecops-bot: Action: revoke-security-group-ingress executed by ben at 2026-03-20T10:23:30Z. Result: Success.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-378 (security-group-exposed-ssh). Severity: low->medium. Notifying on-call.
elena: confirm there was no lateral access — any auth logs for host login attempts?
ben: checking instance logs -> no successful SSH logins from public IPs. Only scan attempts. attaching short log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T10:25:12Z Failed password for invalid user root from 198.51.100.23 port 51322
2026-03-20T10:25:15Z Connection closed by 198.51.100.23
```
maria: i will rollback the terraform change and remove the temp var from the pipeline. opening PR now.
samir: important: which credentials did the CI use? service role can authorize SG changes — we should narrow its permissions.
ben: current role policy: {"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress","ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress","ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute"],"Resource":"*"}]}
ben: that's too broad.
elena: mitigation steps: 1) revoke rule (done). 2) revert infra change (maria PR). 3) update CI role: restrict resource ARNs to specific security groups and remove wildcard. 4) enable terraform plan approvals in prod workspace. 5) add automated guardrail that blocks 0.0.0.0/0 for SSH on apply.
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 — includes revert + removes TEMP_SSH var from prod pipeline.
samir: i will create an IAM change request: tighten ci-runner-role and add conditions on ec2 actions. tagging @infra-owners.
ben: also recommend adding an AWS Config rule and a terraform sentinel/pre-apply check to fail any plan that would add 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22.
elena: audit: run a CloudTrail search for last 30 days for any AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress by ci-runner-role.
samir: running: cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ci-runner-role --start-time 2026-02-18 --end-time 2026-03-20
samir: found 3 events: 2 were benign (revoke+authorize for internal test groups), 1 is today's. no other public exposures.
oncall-bot: Update: incident severity stayed at medium due to potential exposure window (~5 mins). Next: post-incident review scheduled.
elena: follow-ups for postmortem:
- enforce least-privilege on CI roles (IAM ticket)
- add pre-apply guardrail (terraform CI job) and AWS Config rule
- add a quick smoke check that attempts to ssh to any host that opens 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 and fails the deploy
- add audit log alert to pagerduty for any SG change opening 0.0.0.0/0 on SSH
- document incident cause & owner in handbook
maria: apologies. i'll own the postmortem writeup. will include timeline, PRs, and steps taken.
ben: assigned owners: IAM (samir), infra CI policies (elena), postmortem doc (maria). I will follow up to ensure IAM policy patch is rolled.
samir: will create IAM PR: restrict ec2 actions to resource arn:aws:ec2:eu-west-1:123456789012:security-group/sg-* and add "Condition": {"StringNotEquals": {"ec2:Vpc":"vpc-0a1b2c3d"}} - and drop wildcard if possible.
maria: PR merged and deploy done at 10:40. infra revert applied.
elena: adding config rule: aws-config rule 'restricted-ssh-from-internet' created. rule fails and sends to SNS topic infra-alerts.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-378 closed at 2026-03-20T11:05Z. Postmortem doc: https://internal.redwood/pm/INC-2026-378
samir: thanks everyone. small window, no data exfil, lessons learned. closing thread.
